mapper.sql: id, name, logo, description, sort, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select from mall_brand where name = #{name} limit 1

select from mall_brand
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and status = #{status}
order by sort asc, id asc
select from mall_brand where status = 1 order by sort asc, id asc
select count(*) from mall_product where brand_id = #{brandId}
mapper.insert: insert into mall_brand (name, logo, description, sort, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{logo}, #{description}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
